general.name: General Help
text: Welcome to the MUD! Here are some common command categories:
- Movement: 'north', 'south', 'east', 'west', 'up', 'down' (or n, s, e, w, u, d)
- Interaction: 'look', 'get', 'drop', 'equip', 'remove', 'kill', 'talk', 'give'
- Character: 'inventory', 'equipment', 'sheet', 'skills', 'spells'
- Communication: 'say', 'tell <player> <message>'
- Other: 'help <topic>', 'quit'
Type 'help <command_name>' for more details on a specific command.

look.name: Look
text: Syntax: look [target]
- 'look': Shows your current room, its exits, items, and any creatures.
- 'look <target>': Looks more closely at a specific creature, item, or object.

movement.name: Movement
text: Syntax: <direction>
Examples: 'north', 'n', 'east', 'e'
Moves your character in the specified direction if an exit exists.

get.name: Get
text: Syntax: get <item_name> [container_name]
- 'get <item_name>': Picks up an item from the ground in your current room.
- 'get <item_name> <container_name>': Takes an item from a container in the room or your inventory.

drop.name: Drop
text: Syntax: drop <item_name>
Drops an item from your inventory onto the ground in your current room.

inventory.name: Inventory
text: Syntax: inventory
Displays a list of items currently in your inventory.

equipment.name: Equipment
text: Syntax: equipment
Displays a list of items currently equipped on your character.

equip.name: Equip
text: Syntax: equip <item_name> [slot_name]
Equips an item from your inventory. If the item can be equipped in multiple slots, you can optionally specify the slot (e.g., 'equip dagger offhand').

remove.name: Remove
text: Syntax: remove <slot_name_or_item_name>
Removes an equipped item and places it in your inventory. You can specify the slot (e.g., 'remove head') or the item name if it's unique.

kill.name: Kill
text: Syntax: kill <target_name>
Initiates combat with the specified target in your current room.

sheet.name: Sheet
text: Syntax: sheet
Displays your character sheet, including stats, HP, AC, level, and other vital information.

say.name: Say
text: Syntax: say <message>
Broadcasts a message to everyone in your current room.

tell.name: Tell
text: Syntax: tell <player_name> <message>
Sends a private message to another player who is currently online.

quit.name: Quit
text: Syntax: quit
Saves your character and disconnects you from the game.

spells.name: Spells
text: Syntax: spells [known|prepared|available]
- 'spells': Lists spells you currently have prepared (if applicable) or know.
- 'spells known': Lists all spells you know.
- 'spells prepared': Lists spells you have prepared.
- 'spells available': Lists spells available for you to prepare (for preparing classes).
To cast a spell, use 'cast <spell_name> [target] [at <level>]'.
To get help on a specific spell, type 'help <spell_name>'.

cast.name: Cast
text: Syntax: cast <spell_name> [target_name] [at <spell_level>]
- 'cast "fire bolt" goblin': Casts Fire Bolt at a goblin.
- 'cast cure wounds self': Casts Cure Wounds on yourself.
- 'cast magic missile at 3': Casts Magic Missile using a 3rd-level spell slot.
If a spell requires concentration, casting another concentration spell will break it.
Cantrips do not require spell slots.

prepare.name: Prepare
text: Syntax: prepare <spell_name>
For classes that prepare spells (Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Wizard), this command adds a known spell to your list of prepared spells for the day.
You can only prepare a certain number of spells, determined by your class and level.

unprepare.name: Unprepare
text: Syntax: unprepare <spell_name>
Removes a spell from your list of prepared spells, freeing up a preparation slot.
